title: [ng9]  Error: Angular JIT compilation failed: '@angular/compiler' not loaded!

# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/.... ### Is this a regression? Yes, the previous version in which this bug was not present was: ng8 ### Description ng serve is running properly there is no error but sometime we are getting this in web browser console then we need to restart ng serve in order to work again ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://stackblitz.com/... ## 🔥 Exception or Error
